title: Canary cassette traffic orchestration for SDK E2E (multi-lang streaming + retry profiles)
creator: Priya Patel
description: Goal: Build a deterministic but flexible cassette-based traffic harness that (1) runs multi-language SDK E2E (Python/TS/Go) against a replayable recorded traffic corpus, (2) simulates streaming token frames + per-token latency profiles, and (3) exercises retry/backpressure code paths deterministically so CI can detect regressions in streaming ergonomics and retry behavior. This ticket implements the orchestration and CI gating, not the corpus collection.
acceptance_criteria: CI job 'sdk-cassette-canary' runs on PRs and returns deterministic pass/fail across 3 consecutive runs
Harness supports language-specific adapters for Python/TS/Go that map SDK calls to the cassette format
Support at least three latency profiles (low/median/high) and a configurable backpressure model (token-drop / delayed frames)
Retry paths are exercised: transient 5xx, connection reset, and partial-stream-abort — validated by assertion hooks in tests
Recorded golden session artifact format documented and stored in /artifacts/golden-sessions with checksums
notes: Trade-offs considered: full network emulation increases fidelity but slows CI; we opted for a hybrid approach: deterministic cassette with probabilistic latency morphing to catch timing-sensitive bugs while staying fast. We will not attempt to fully emulate GPU-side kernel timings — out of scope for this cycle.
comments: 2025-02-19 Priya Patel: Initial spec sketched in Confluence. Decided to use an append-only cassette format (chronicle.jsonl) to make patching and diffs easier.
